title: 第9章 无耻嘴脸第10章 登门认错
lines: 随着刘桂香的话语落下，这泼辣、这腔调；再加上刘桂香那狰狞的老脸上扭曲的表情。怎么看都怎么让人心生厌恶。
所有人都被镇住了。每一个人的表情都是大同小异。这…还能这么玩啊。每一个人都感觉自己的三观被刷新了。没有最下限，只有更下限啊。
那正义感爆棚的女记者，直接开喷：“你知不知道你是在敲诈勒索。你这是诈骗？”
刘桂香泼妇的性子起来了：“小姑娘，谁诈骗了，谁诈骗了。我之前就是瘫痪了，难道还不允许我好啊。你是咒我是吧。”
曹天赐也跟着回过神来了。一脸凶相的瞪着女记者，道：“美女，说话要有根据。你这是什么意思？小心我告你诽谤。”
说到这曹天赐直接道：“妈，走了走了。虽然腿脚是好了。可指不定还有什么后遗症啥的。我们先去医院住着，好好的疗养检查一番。”
说着，曹天赐转头道：“陈警官，既然我妈没有瘫痪了。那就过几天再调解吧。”
此刻所有人都明白为何曹天赐这厮会变成一个无赖混混了。有这么一个老娘，耳濡目染之下，没有变成凶犯就已经算他厉害了。
更关键的是，所有人都发现，即便能揣测出来事实的真相。可刘桂香这么狡辩的话，还真没什么好的办法。谁让那边没有监控，也找不到证人呢。
陈警官已经扯住了高山，低声道：“小高啊，这两母子就是滚刀肉。没有道德廉耻，没有下限的人。你们找不到证人就无法脱清关系。现在这事出来，我看不如趁机解决了。这么住下去，你们也拖不起啊。”
事实证明，这个世界还是好人多啊。陈警官的话语让高山也颇为感慨，这也证明刘桂香母子的做法的确是不得人心。
从陈警官的角度出发，这无疑是最好的选择。刚才穿帮的事情已经让刘桂香母子的气势降到了最低点。如果趁机调解，他们也不敢狮子大开口。可高山不怕，昨天是对自己的医门传承没有了解。可随着高山将整个传承都捋了一遍之后，高山就不怕了。
尽管高山的气术才刚刚入门。很多神秘玄妙的技能都运用不了。可对付这对无耻的母子那绝对是足够了。
想到这里，高山也低声道：“陈队，这条花蛇也有三斤多了，您就拿着回去做口味蛇吧。我去跟她们说几句。”
高山不等陈警官有何表示，直接把蛇递给了陈警官，然后就迎了上去。一副自来熟的样子，一手扶住了刘桂香的手臂，一手拉住了曹天赐。高山微笑着道：“就是，就得多住一段时间。反正你们有钱嘛。”
话说着，可刹那之间高山的脸色却一下就变得苍白起来。人都抖动了几下，差点就站不稳了。
高山这个表现一下就让曹天赐跳了起来。直接跳开一步，一脸警惕的看着高山，大声道：“干嘛，想干嘛啊。想讹人是吧。大家可都看见了啊。我们可没有碰你。哎！你小子赶紧的把手给我松开。别扶着我妈。要不然我们也说不清了。”
曹天赐嘴上说着，手上动作也不慢。直接简单而粗暴的拉开了高山。而高山也似乎是筋疲力尽一样，这么一拉，直接就瘫坐在了地上。
看到高山的样子，曹天赐立刻就大声道：“都看到了啊。都看到了啊。这可跟我没有关系。是他自己的原因。”
就在曹天赐说话的刹那，高山也低声道：“曹天赐，你会来找我的。”
高庆国再第一时间就上来了，脸色紧张的看着高山：“山伢子，你没事吧。”
在父亲的搀扶之下，高山坐在了旁边的沙发上，又接过了陈警官递过来的水，连喝了几口之后，这才缓和了不少。看着旁边老父担心的神情，高山摆了摆手，他连说话的力气都没有了。
刚才高山并不是无缘无故的倒下。实际他对刘桂香母子用了医门传承里面的一些秘术。只不过高山没有想到这秘术对自己的消耗竟然会如此的巨大。此刻高山心中有些明悟，气术果然才是根本。如果没有气术的支撑，且不说那些玄妙莫测的医学无法使用，即便使用也会让自己身体亏空。
随着老爸高庆国不断的拍打、抚摸着后背，高山也逐渐的缓了过来，道：“爸，你放心吧。刚才就是脑子突然晕了一下。现在已经没什么事情了。我们先回去吧。就不打扰陈队的工作了。”
高家这边的事情且不说，医院这边，刘桂香母子也已经回到了医院了。虽然不能再装什么瘫痪了，可是，刘桂香也不在意，这样反而更好。装瘫可是太难受了。虽说现在能要的赔偿少了。可刘桂香不怕。大不了就是住呗。还怕对方不屈服么？
大约一个半小时之后。那刘桂香突然就尖叫了起来。起因是他想去上厕所。可是，这一动，她却发现自己双下肢根本就不听使唤，没有知觉了。
“天赐！天赐啊。我这腿是怎么了？怎么我没有知觉了。”刘桂香慌乱的叫了起来。
曹天赐原本还在旁边的陪床上酣然大睡呢，被刘桂香这么一吵，立刻就坐了起来，迷迷糊糊道：“我的老娘哎，你还装个什么啊。都已经穿帮了。难不成还装上瘾了啊。”
刘桂香立刻就怒骂起来：“你个化生子！老子没跟你扯淡，你赶紧的叫医生过来看一下，老子该不会是真的瘫了吧。那怎么得了哦。就你这二赖子的性格，老子怕是会饿死了。”
知子莫若父，刘桂香又当爹、又当妈的养大曹天赐，还真是了解自家儿子。还没确定是怎么回事呢，立刻就哀嚎起来。
曹天赐骂骂咧咧的站了起来，道：“吼啥啊，吼，瘫了正好。这下我看他们怎么说，看我不把那家子给诈出血来！”
不一会儿，医生来了，护士也来了。一番的检查下来之后，为首的医生很是严肃的看着刘桂香和曹天赐道：“的确没有反应了，各项神经反射都呈阳性。”
医生是一个年约四十岁左右的中年男子，带着一副银丝边的眼镜，整个人很斯文，很学术。语气有些沉重，更有些公式化：“在这之前，我们一直都在怀疑，你们母子俩是故意装出来想要讹诈对方的。恕我直言，我们骨伤科接触的车祸患者实在是太多了。各种各样的人都有。现在看来是我们错怪你们了。”
“你…！”曹天赐很想骂人，有这么说话的么？怎么感觉怎么听都不太习惯啊。另外，曹天赐突然想到了一个问题。
content_en:
As Liu Guixiang's words fell, this aggressive, this tone; coupled with the twisted expression on Liu Guixiang's ferocious old face. No matter how you look at it, it's disgusting.
Everyone was stunned. Everyone's expression is similar. This... can still be played like this. Everyone felt that their outlook on life had been refreshed. There is no lower limit, only a lower limit.
The female reporter, who had a strong sense of justice, directly complained: "Do you know that you are extorting money? Are you committing fraud?"
Liu Guixiang's shrewish temper grew: "Little girl, whoever defrauded me, whoever defrauded me. I was paralyzed before. Why don't you allow me to be better? You are cursing me, right?"
Cao Tianci also came to his senses. He stared at the female reporter with a fierce expression and said, "Beauty, what you say must be well-founded. What do you mean? Be careful, I will sue you for slander."
Speaking of this, Cao Tianci said directly: "Mom, let's go. Although my legs and feet are healed, there may be any sequelae or something like that. Let's go to the hospital first and get a good recuperation and check-up."
With that said, Cao Tianci turned around and said, "Officer Chen, since my mother is not paralyzed. Let's mediate in a few days."
At this moment, everyone understood why Cao Tianci turned into a rogue. With such an old woman, under the influence of her ears and eyes, even if she didn't become a murderer, she would be considered powerful.
More importantly, everyone discovered that even if they could guess the truth. But if Liu Guixiang is so quibly, there really is no good way. Why is there no surveillance over there and no witnesses can be found?
Officer Chen had already grabbed Gao Shan and said in a low voice: "Xiao Gao, these two mother and son are a piece of meat. They have no moral integrity and no lower limit. You can't get rid of the relationship if you can't find a witness. Now that this matter has come out, I think it's better to take the opportunity to solve it. If we continue to live like this, you can't afford it."
Facts have proved that there are still many good people in this world. Officer Chen's words made Gao Shan quite emotional, which also proved that the actions of Liu Guixiang and her son were indeed unpopular.
From Officer Chen's perspective, this is undoubtedly the best choice. What happened just now has brought the momentum of Liu Guixiang and her son to the lowest point. If they take the opportunity to mediate, they will not dare to speak loudly. But Gao Shan is not afraid. Yesterday, he did not understand his medical heritage. But after Gao Shan went through the entire inheritance, Gao Shan was no longer afraid.
Although Gao Shan's Qi jutsu has just begun. Many mysterious and mysterious skills cannot be used. But that's definitely enough to deal with this shameless mother and son.
Thinking of this, Gao Shan also whispered: "Team Chen, this flower snake weighs more than three kilograms. You can take it back to make a flavor snake. I'll go and talk to them."
Gao Shan didn't wait for Officer Chen to say anything, directly handed the snake to Officer Chen, and then greeted him. With a familiar look, he held Liu Guixiang's arm with one hand and held Cao Tianci with the other. Gao Shan smiled and said: "That's right, we just need to stay longer. You have money anyway."
As he spoke, Gao Shan's face turned pale in an instant. Everyone shook a few times and almost lost their balance.
Gao Shan's performance made Cao Tianci jump up. He jumped a step away, looked at Gao Shan with a vigilant face, and said loudly: "What are you doing? What do you want to do? You want to blackmail someone, right? Everyone saw it. We didn't touch you. Hey! You kid, please let me go quickly. Don't hold my mother. Otherwise we won't be able to tell you clearly."
Cao Tianci said this while moving his hands slowly. He simply and roughly pulled away the mountain. And Gao Shan seemed to be exhausted. After pulling like this, he collapsed on the ground.
Seeing Gao Shan's appearance, Cao Tianci immediately said loudly: "I've seen it all. I've seen it all. This has nothing to do with me. It's his own fault."
The moment Cao Tianci spoke, Gao Shan also whispered: "Cao Tianci, you will come to me."
Gao Qingguo came up immediately and looked at Gao Shan nervously: "Shan Yaozi, are you okay?"
With the support of his father, Gao Shan sat on the sofa next to him and took the water from Officer Chen. After taking a few sips, he felt relieved. Seeing the worried expression of the old father next to him, Gao Shan waved his hand. He didn't even have the strength to speak.
The mountain didn't fall down just now for no reason. In fact, he used some secret techniques inherited from the medical sect on Liu Guixiang and her son. It's just that Gao Shan didn't expect that this secret technique would consume so much on him. At this moment, Gao Shan had some clarity in his heart, and Qi magic was indeed the foundation. Without the support of Qi techniques, not to mention those mysterious and unpredictable medicines that cannot be used, even if you use them, your body will suffer a loss.
As his father Gao Qingguo kept patting and stroking his back, Gao Shan gradually calmed down and said: "Dad, don't worry. I just felt dizzy just now. There's nothing wrong now. Let's go back first. I won't disturb Team Chen's work."
…
Not to mention the affairs of the Gao family, Liu Guixiang and her son have also returned to the hospital. Although he could no longer pretend to be paralyzed, Liu Guixiang didn't care. This would be better. Pretending to be paralyzed is too uncomfortable. Although the compensation you can ask for now is less. But Liu Guixiang is not afraid. The worst thing is to stay. Are you still afraid that the other party won't give in?
About an hour and a half later. Liu Guixiang suddenly screamed. The reason was that he wanted to go to the toilet. However, with this movement, she found that her lower limbs were not functioning at all and had no feeling.
"Godsend! Godsend. What's wrong with my legs? Why can't I feel anything?" Liu Guixiang shouted in panic.
Cao Tianci was still sleeping soundly on the bed next to him. When Liu Guixiang made such a noise, he immediately sat up and said in a daze: "My dear, what are you pretending to be? You are already in trouble. Could it be that you are still pretending to be addicted?"
Liu Guixiang immediately yelled angrily: "You're a metamorphosis! I'm not talking nonsense to you. Please call the doctor over to see if I'm really paralyzed. What's the matter? With your character, I'm afraid I'll starve to death."
A son is better known than his father. Liu Guixiang raised Cao Tianci as both father and mother. She really understood her son. Before he could figure out what was going on, he started wailing immediately.
Cao Tianci stood up and cursed, saying: "What are you yelling at? It's just a good time to be paralyzed. Now let's see what they say, and see if I don't trick that family into bleeding out!"
After a while, the doctor came and the nurse came too. After some examinations, the leading doctor looked at Liu Guixiang and Cao Tianci very seriously and said: "There is indeed no reaction, and all the nerve reflexes are positive."
The doctor is a middle-aged man about forty years old. He wears a pair of silver-rimmed glasses. He is very polite and academic. The tone was a little heavy and formulaic: "Before this, we have always suspected that you, mother and son, were deliberately pretending to blackmail each other. With all due respect, our Orthopedics and Traumatology Department has come into contact with too many car accident patients. There are all kinds of people. Now it seems that we have wrongly blamed you."
"You...!" Cao Tianci wanted to curse. Is there anyone who would say something like this? It feels like I’m not used to it no matter how much I listen to it. In addition, Cao Tianci suddenly thought of a question.
title_en: Chapter 9 Shameless Face Chapter 10 Come to admit your mistake
